name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia fired more than 80 cruise missiles and about 400 drones on 20 Nov, one of the war's largest attacks
state: Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched more than 80 cruise missiles, up to 20 ballistic missiles and around 400 drones overnight into 20 Nov, mainly at the energy system, causing outages in western regions (UNN). In Kyiv three water-utility workers were killed, about 15 civilians injured and three Dnipro bridges damaged; officials reported eight killed across Kyiv and nine regions (Kyiv Independent; UNN). The attack followed Putin's vow of revenge for Ukraine's 17 Nov strike on the Crimean Bridge.
for_you: For travel, follow FCDO advice, which warns against all travel to Ukraine. Mass strikes on energy can cause long power and water outages in winter for people in Ukraine.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes: 80+ cruise missiles and ~400 drones on 20 Nov
